Title: TOM: Q: AH: Clan Impersonation and becoming uncontrolled

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
If my Gangrel passes himself off as a Toreador via Clan Impersonation,
and is later Banished (or Peace of Ket.ed) back to my uncontrolled
region, can he be the benefeciary of Eco Terrorists or Art Museum?

I'm assuming that he can be targetted only by the Eco Terrorists, since
the Clan Impersonation is a minion card, and will thus be out of play
while the target is uncontrolled.
